report_name: Hart District Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify routes with the greatest potential for increasing commuter cycling and school cycling, to test the emerging network, and to visually validate the proposed cycle network.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation methodology was developed by Hampshire County Council, assessing routes against four categories: effectiveness, policy, economics, and deliverability, using a scoring system of 1 to 3.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP has informed the development of the Green Grid, including a pilot route between Hartland Village and Fleet Railway Station (opened Summer 2022), and has been used to identify and prioritise specific infrastructure improvements such as the Reading Road North/Elvetham Road roundabout improvements.
pct_usage_quote: In addition to the clustering exercise, the PCT has been used to identify which routes within the study area have the greatest potential for an increase in the number of commuters cycling to work and the number of children cycling to school.
local_authority_name: Hart District Council and Hampshire County Council
